why: "1 lives left" at exactly the moment the number matters most. The summary exists to build confidence about a run the player is deciding whether to continue, and the last life is when it is read most carefully -- a wording defect there costs more trust than the same defect at three. Invisible to any assertion that only checks the line contains the number.
killedBy: hud: the replace-run confirmation (issue #226) names the run it would replace
hud: the Main Menu hierarchy (issue #226) says "1 life left", and degrades to the lives half when the mission cannot be resolved
